notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from the public browardtax.org Property Tax page (no sign-in, no lookup). Box 105048, Atlanta, GA 30348-5048 (overnight 3585 Atlanta Avenue, Hapeville, GA 30354-1705); drop box and office at 115 S. Andrews Ave, Fort Lauderdale. No pay-by-phone channel is listed (inferred unsupported). Discounts 4% Nov, 3% Dec, 2% Jan, 1% Feb; due March 31; delinquent April 1 with a 3% interest charge plus advertising costs; tax certificate sale on or about June 1. Partial payments: up to five, minimum $100, enabled by email/phone/memo line. Installment payment plan: apply online from the account search (Nov 1-Apr 30), confirm by email; 6%/4.5%/3% discounts; first installment by June 30 for the full discount, July 31 at the latest; payment_arrangement is supported for that online application. No e-bill sign-up is described (paperless unknown). Email sign-in is synthetic.

public.label: Pay Online, By Mail or In Person

guest_pay.note: Search your account and pay online: eCheck with no fee, or credit/debit card with a 2.55% processor fee.

autopay.note: There is no automatic payment program. Pay online, by mail or in person, or join the Installment Payment Plan and pay each installment yourself.

paperless.note: Property tax bills are mailed on November 1. For questions about receiving your bill, call 954-357-4829.

pay_by_phone.note: Property taxes are paid online, by mail or in person; no phone payment line is listed.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a check payable to Broward County Tax Collector with the payment coupon to P.O. Box 105048, Atlanta, GA 30348-5048.

payment_arrangement.note: Apply for next year's installment plan from your account search between November 1 and April 30, then confirm by email. Partial payments (up to five, $100 minimum) must first be enabled by the office.

importantDates: Tax bills are mailed by November 1 and are paid once a year.
Paying early earns a discount: 4% in November, 3% in December, 2% in January and 1% in February. March payments are the full amount.
Taxes are due by March 31 and become delinquent on April 1.

notes: eCheck payments with wrong account details or returned unpaid may be charged up to 5%.

help.title: Ways to pay property tax
paragraphs: Online, pay by credit or debit card with a 2.55% fee charged by the payment processor, or by electronic check with no fee. An eCheck with wrong account details or one returned unpaid may be charged up to 5%.

By mail, make the check payable to Broward County Tax Collector, include the pre-printed payment coupon, and send it to P.O. Box 105048, Atlanta, GA 30348-5048 (overnight: 3585 Atlanta Avenue, Hapeville, GA 30354-1705). Payments without a coupon are delayed; returned checks are charged a fee and the payment is cancelled.

In person, use the secure drop box at the Broward County Governmental Center, 115 S. Andrews Ave, Fort Lauderdale (checks or money orders only, with your coupon and tax account number), or see a Client Service Specialist in the office.

help.title: Due dates and early-payment discounts
paragraphs: Bills are mailed and become payable on November 1 and must be paid by March 31. Paying early saves 4% in November, 3% in December, 2% in January and 1% in February.

Unpaid taxes become delinquent on April 1, with a 3% interest charge plus advertising costs. Around June 1 the Tax Collector sells tax certificates on delinquent properties; after that, payment must be by cash, cashier's check, money order or wire. If taxes stay unpaid two years, the certificate holder can apply for a tax deed.

help.title: Partial payments
paragraphs: You can pay the current tax bill in up to five partial payments of at least $100 each. To enroll, email Revenue@BrowardTax.org, call 954-357-4829, or write "partial payment" in the memo line of your mailed check. To pay partial amounts online, contact the office first to enable your account.

help.title: Installment Payment Plan
paragraphs: The installment plan saves an average of 3.5%. Enrollment is open November 1 through April 30 for the next tax year: search for your account, choose to apply for the installment plan, submit the application and answer the confirmation email. You do not need to reapply each year.

Installments: by June 30, one quarter of last year's taxes discounted 6%; by September 30, one quarter discounted 4.5%; by December 31, half of this year's adjusted taxes discounted 3%; by March 31, the remaining half. Pay the first installment by June 30 for the full discount; it is accepted until July 31.

extra.intent: Using the Broward County Tax Collector website's help pages, find the minimum amount of each partial property tax payment. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Each partial payment must be at least $100, up to five payments.
